source: TSTD project (TA 7305-CAM), "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដំណាំពោត" (Corn Cultivation Technical Manual), Section 5: Harvest, May 2012
text: Fresh/baby corn can generally be harvested from about 65 to 75 days after planting, picked while the ear is still tender (before full maturity). Depending on the variety, each plant produces about 1 harvestable ear. Farmers can pick every day so that the harvested corn is uniform and not overripe.
